messages:
deploy-bot: Urgent hotfix request for embeddings-service. Image: rwinference/embeds:1.8.1-hotfix. CI green. Requesting expedited canary + fast ramp. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1748007777 :rotating_light:

eng-zoe: TL;DR: batching selector regression causing p99 tail on short payloads. Patch is a small selector fix. Rollback target: 1.8.0.

sre-matt: Rollback triggers? Recommend: p95 +250ms for 3m OR 5xx >0.5% sustained 2m. Who will cut traffic?

oncall-kim: I'm oncall, will monitor and execute traffic cut if needed. Pager set to high for 90m.

product-ryan: Product ack. Small customer impact; approve expedited path. Blurb: "Fix for short-input latency spikes; no model changes."

release-lina: Need Eng + SRE recorded approvals. Please confirm plan and rollback commands.

eng-zoe: +1 eng (codeowner). Plan: canary eu-west1 6m -> 30% 8m -> 100% if healthy. Rollback cmd: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.8.0` and traffic cut: `POST /ops/traffic?service=embeds&target=1.8.0`.

deploy-bot: Starting canary on embed-canary-51. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1748007777

sre-matt: Canary checks PASS after 4m. p95 back to baseline. Proceed to 30%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete. Monitoring.

eng-zoe: 8m into 30%: metrics stable, no error spike. Proceed to final ramp.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout -> switching 100% to rwinference/embeds:1.8.1-hotfix. Deployment finished. Artifact SHA: c3f2b1a0.

release-lina: Scheduled 1h post-deploy check. Closing thread unless issues arise. :white_check_mark:
